name: Rebuild 2 Plan
description: Finish the rebuild2 mart-maintenance cutover so dirty-refresh, large-rebuild, archived cleanup, quarantine, and judgment import paths are bounded, fenced, and resumable for 2M-article projects.

userStories.title: Add dirty-state materialization schema and final token names
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want durable project-wide dirty-state materialization and dirty-token naming so project-wide work can be resumed and ACKed without legacy refresh-token fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Add durable project-wide dirty-state materialization state with source kind, target dirty token, cursor, inserted row count, source scope snapshot/high-water or fingerprint, status, owner/lease fields, and timestamps.

Rename dirty-refresh state columns and API fields from refresh-token terminology to dirty-token terminology, including `last_completed_refresh_token` to `last_completed_dirty_token`, without parallel legacy field names.
Materialization state updates, cursor advancement, completion, failure marking, and token exposure are fenced by materialization owner, lease, dirty token, source snapshot/high-water, and status.
Schema migrations are schema-only and do not clear obsolete queue, dirty, rebuild, quarantine, outbox, or lease state.

userStories.title: Implement DB-side project-wide dirty materialization
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want project-wide dirty work to insert article IDs in database batches so 2M-article scopes never materialize article IDs in JavaScript.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace project-wide dirty-state creation that collects scoped article IDs in JS with DB-side `INSERT ... SELECT` batches against the final versioned project scope source.
Each target dirty token records and validates the versioned project scope generation/high-water it read, and concurrent scope mutations create later dirty tokens instead of mixing source states.
Before marking materialization complete, reconcile inserted article rows against the recorded scope generation/high-water, expected row count, and source fingerprint where available.
Failed, incomplete, or unreconciled materializations keep their dirty token unclaimable until repaired or superseded.

userStories.title: Enforce dirty-token ACK barriers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dirty-token completion to advance only through fully materialized and processed tokens so stale freshness or ACK state cannot skip failed work.
acceptanceCriteria: Project `last_completed_dirty_token`, completed-through markers, owner ACKs, and freshness status do not advance past incomplete, failed, or unreconciled project-wide article materialization.
Project ACK/completed-token advancement uses contiguous-token advancement across completed materialization, unresolved quarantine barriers, and processed dirty-refresh work.
Later processed-past-barrier rows never allow skipping an earlier incomplete, failed, unreconciled, or quarantined token.
Crash recovery covers before materialization state creation, after state before article insert, mid-batch, after article insert before completion, and after completion before worker wake.

userStories.title: Rewrite callers to dirty-state or large-rebuild requests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want every project, prompt, import, human-assessment, and repair caller to write dirty-state or guarded large-rebuild work directly so legacy queue rows cannot be recreated.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace all callers of `queueProjectRefresh`, `queueProjectRefreshes`, `queueProjectRefreshesByImportRouteIds`, `queueProjectRefreshesByPromptIds`, `queueJudgmentArticleRefresh`, `queueJudgmentArticleRefreshes`, `queueJudgmentArticleRefreshesByJudgmentIds`, `queueJudgmentArticleRefreshesByPromptIds`, and `queueImportedArticleRefreshes` with direct dirty-state or guarded large-rebuild writes.

Project create/edit/clone, project-article deletes, subproject creation, human assessment submission, prompt edits, import-store writes, archive, unarchive, backfill, purge, and repair-script work mark the exact affected dirty state and do not recreate queue rows.
Delete old queue-named exports in the same slice and do not leave no-op wrappers.

userStories.title: Make judgment storage and outbox import ACK-safe
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want judgment persistence and SQLite outbox import to make dirty work durable before ACKs so imported judgments cannot become visible without refresh work.
acceptanceCriteria: `judgeStoreJudgment` stores the judgment and marks affected projects dirty atomically; if dirty-state marking fails, the judgment write is not silently committed as ACK-safe.
SQLite judgment outbox ACK occurs only after the committed DuckDB boundary containing judgment upsert, idempotency key/outbox import marker, and durable dirty-state or materialization request.
Normal judgment-import ACK does not wait for dirty-refresh/mart maintenance, while project dirty-refresh ACK remains blocked by unresolved quarantine.
Recovery is idempotent after DuckDB insertion before dirty marking, after dirty marking before SQLite ACK, and after SQLite ACK before maintenance-lease completion.

userStories.title: Add fenced rebuild2 cutover command
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one fenced `db:duck:rebuild2-cutover` command so obsolete intermediate state is cleared only after legacy writers are impossible and replacement work is rederived safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `db:duck:rebuild2-cutover` to acquire the durable exclusive cutover fence, pause workers, wait for active workers to stop or leases to expire, and make stale obsolete invocations fail closed.
The command verifies deployed clean-cut code removed obsolete legacy queue, refresh, rebuild, quarantine, and outbox write paths before clearing state.
The command clears obsolete queue, dirty, rebuild, quarantine, outbox, and lease state only while fenced, then rederives replacement dirty-refresh or large-rebuild work under the cutover owner token.
The command repeats no-legacy-caller and no-obsolete-row-recreation proofs after clearing and after workers resume, and never publishes ACKs from clearing alone.

userStories.title: Delete legacy mart refresh queue paths
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want legacy mart refresh queue paths removed after fenced cutover so no live code can recreate obsolete queue rows.
acceptanceCriteria: `db:duck:rebuild2-cutover` clears all remaining `app.mart_refresh_queue` rows, including non-project scopes such as `judgment_article`, and verifies no rows remain before schema-only table-drop migration is allowed.
Drop the already-cleared `app.mart_refresh_queue` table through schema-only DDL after fenced cutover; the migration does not clear rows or perform cutover-state validation.
Delete queue schema repair code, queue APIs, queue CLI/package scripts, queue scripts/tests, legacy queue pruning code, `martRefreshDrainHeartbeat`, and `startBackgroundWork` queue-drain wiring.
No no-op queue wrappers remain and former callers cannot recreate queue rows.

userStories.title: Implement quarantine ACK barrier semantics
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want quarantined dirty articles to remain durable while allowing non-quarantined work to proceed without advancing project ACK past the barrier.
acceptanceCriteria: Unresolved quarantine rows are keyed by project, article, and dirty token, and project `last_completed_dirty_token`, owner ACKs, mart-maintenance outbox ACKs, and completed-through markers do not advance past the earliest unresolved quarantined token.
Claims process non-quarantined rows, persist processed-past-barrier state, and release or park as `blocked_by_quarantine` without treating that as project ACK/completion.
Redirty after a barrier keeps the earlier processed token and creates or reopens later dirty-refresh work without allowing ACK advancement to skip the later change.
Bounded cleanup prunes only already-resolved quarantine rows after project ACK advances past the barrier.

userStories.title: Rename quarantine storage and CLIs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want dirty-refresh quarantine tables and commands to use final names and preserve ACK barriers so quarantine operations are explicit and auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: During fenced `db:duck:rebuild2-cutover` only, clear obsolete article-only quarantine rows and rederive required current quarantine/dirty-refresh work under the cutover owner token.

After cutover, a schema-only migration renames `app.project_mart_refresh_article_quarantine` to `app.project_mart_dirty_refresh_article_quarantine` and applies project/article dirty-token-scoped DDL without deleting, rewriting, backfilling, migrating, or validating obsolete rows.
Rename package commands to `db:duck:quarantine-dirty-refresh-article` and `db:duck:unquarantine-dirty-refresh-article`, and delete old refresh-named scripts in the same slice.
CLI tests prove impacted projects are reported and blocked state is released only through explicit unquarantine/retry.

userStories.title: Harden dirty-refresh batch execution
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dirty-refresh batches to use bounded SQL inputs and durable wake budgets so normal judgment churn remains O(dirty articles).
acceptanceCriteria: Replace generated dirty article `VALUES` and `IN (...)` lists with DuckDB temp or staging batch tables throughout dirty-refresh SQL.

Dirty-refresh batch transactions keep `mart.project_scope_article`, `mart.prompt_answer_fact`, `app.review_answer_dictionary`, rollup, serving, detail, and filter-member rows internally consistent for each committed batch.
Dirty-refresh worker wakes stop on wall-clock budget, leave durable progress, and resume the next wake without reprocessing completed batches.
Ten dirty articles in a 2M-article project claim at most those ten article IDs and do not run project-wide downstream deletes for the claim.

userStories.title: Harden large-rebuild lease and promotion fencing
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want large-rebuild state transitions and promotion fenced by lease, token, generation, and supersession so stale workers cannot publish or clean up newer state.
acceptanceCriteria: Every large-rebuild state transition is guarded by worker, lease, phase, token, and target generation, including cursor updates, phase advancement, active-generation promotion, cleanup eligibility, and completed/ACK markers.

Frozen scope records the rebuild source dirty-token/high-water, and promotion carries forward later dirty-refresh work or marks it pending against the promoted generation before reporting the project fully fresh.
Only the current non-superseded rebuild token may promote for a project/rebuild kind; older superseded rebuilds cannot promote, mark completion, advance ACKs, or make cleanup eligible.
Old-generation cleanup is generation-scoped, lease-fenced, batch-bounded, and rechecks active, target, retained, and referenced generation state at delete time.

userStories.title: Replace large-rebuild operator commands and APIs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want explicit request and worker command names so normal dirty-maintenance paths are not confused with structural large-rebuild work.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace `db:duck:rebuild-marts`, `db:duck:backfill-review-serving-v3`, `db:duck:refresh-project-once`, `db:duck:run-large-rebuild-cycle`, and `db:duck:run-large-rebuild-cycles` with final commands: `db:duck:request-project-large-rebuild`, `db:duck:request-review-serving-large-rebuild`, `db:duck:run-large-rebuild-worker-once`, and `db:duck:run-large-rebuild-worker-cycles`.

Rename queue-named large-rebuild APIs to `requestLargeRebuild`, `requestProjectLargeRebuild`, `requestProjectLargeRebuilds`, `requestLargeRebuildsForDirtyStates`, and `requestProjectLargeRebuildForDirtyArticles`.
Rename `getDuckdbMartRefreshService` and tests to `getDuckdbMartMaintenanceService` after queue deletion.
Package commands expose final rebuild2 command surface, omit obsolete command names, and keep no no-op compatibility wrappers.

userStories.title: Replace repair and operational refresh scripts
userStories.description: As an operator, I want repair and risk scripts to schedule current dirty-refresh or large-rebuild work without hand-written table surgery or project-refresh terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: Rework `scripts/repairOwnedProjectPrompts.ts` so repaired prompt/judgment rows create replacement dirty work through DB-side project-wide dirty-state materialization with durable cursor/status.

Replace `db:duck:inspect-project-refresh-risk` and `db:duck:recover-project-refresh-claims` with `db:duck:inspect-dirty-refresh-risk` and `db:duck:recover-dirty-refresh-claims` that understand dirty-state materialization, quarantine barriers, scope, and large-rebuild leases.

Delete `db:duck:repair-project-refresh-ledger` and replace `db:duck:repair-judgment-fact` with `db:duck:request-judgment-fact-repair` that schedules current structural repair or large-rebuild work instead of hand-written table surgery.
No repair command drops, recreates, truncates, or clears obsolete queue, dirty, rebuild, quarantine, outbox, or lease state outside fenced `db:duck:rebuild2-cutover`.

userStories.title: Move archived-project deletion to tombstone cleanup
userStories.description: As a user, I want archived project deletion to return quickly while bounded cleanup finishes safely in the background without deleting shared judgment facts.
acceptanceCriteria: `/api/projects/delete-archived` creates tombstone/delete-pending cleanup work instead of synchronously purging marts and rebuilding app tables in the request path.
Tombstoned projects are hidden from normal API/UI reads while retaining enough identity for bounded cleanup to finish and final deletion to clear the tombstone.

Final project identity/source rows are not deleted until referencing dirty-state materialization, dirty-refresh, quarantine, large-rebuild, bounded cleanup, and judgment outbox/import health projection work is completed, resolved, or non-active tombstoned without ACK advancement.
Archived cleanup uses `db:duck:run-archived-project-bounded-cleanup` and deletes old purge/repro scripts and `db:duck:purge-archived-marts`.

userStories.title: Preserve judgment facts and dictionary stability in cleanup
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want archived cleanup and repair paths to preserve shared judgment facts and append-only answer dictionary IDs so active serving rows stay valid.
acceptanceCriteria: Make global `mart.judgment_fact` project-independent for archived cleanup by treating judgment/config identity as fact identity and moving project/snapshot display metadata to project-scoped serving/detail rows.
Archived cleanup removes only deleted-project project-scoped metadata and preserves global/shared judgment facts still visible to non-archived projects.
`app.review_answer_dictionary` remains shared stable dictionary metadata; no dirty-refresh, large-rebuild, repair, or cleanup path deletes and renumbers dictionary IDs.
Dictionary pruning proves no in-progress target generation, retained generation, active serving row, detail row, or filter-member row references the ID before pruning.

userStories.title: Update review warnings and judgment freshness APIs
userStories.description: As a user, I want review warnings and judgment-job counts to explain dirty-state materialization, dirty-refresh, quarantine, and large-rebuild status without blocking reads or hiding stale freshness.
acceptanceCriteria: Judgment-job unassessed count/article routes treat incomplete project-wide dirty-state materialization and unresolved quarantine barriers as not-fully-fresh and return explicit pending/stale status plus bounded mart/read-model values.

Review warnings API and review indexing copy reflect dirty-state materialization, dirty-refresh, quarantine barriers, bounded cleanup, and large-rebuild states without exposing admin-only diagnostics in the user banner.

API and OLAP review filters and article review details return the same active-generation data before, during, and after dirty-state materialization, dirty-refresh, large-rebuild, promotion, and cleanup lag.
Detailed rows/sec, RSS, temp spill, and DuckDB writer queue-wait diagnostics remain API/admin-only.

userStories.title: Update review UI indexing warnings
userStories.description: As a user, I want browser and desktop review pages to stay usable while dirty-refresh or large-rebuild work is pending or running.
acceptanceCriteria: Review UI copy shows user-actionable status, counts, and last-progress timestamps for dirty-state materialization, dirty-refresh, quarantine, bounded cleanup, and large-rebuild work.
The review page does not expose admin-only rows/sec, RSS, temp spill, or DuckDB queue-wait diagnostics in the user banner.
Browser/web and desktop review flows remain usable while dirty-refresh or large-rebuild work is pending or running.
Manual browser and desktop reviews-page smoke passes

userStories.title: Audit final package commands and docs
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want package scripts and documentation to expose only final rebuild2 commands so operators cannot accidentally use obsolete compatibility paths.
acceptanceCriteria: `package.json` exposes final rebuild2 package commands and omits obsolete command names, no-op compatibility wrappers, and old aliases.
`db:duck:rebuild2-cutover` is the only command allowed to clear obsolete queue, dirty, rebuild, quarantine, outbox, or lease state.
Active docs/package references to obsolete command names are removed except historical migration notes.
`AGENTS.md` and current README/docs references use final dirty-refresh, dirty-materialization, large-rebuild, and bounded-cleanup terminology.

userStories.title: Run final rebuild2 integration and performance verification
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want final end-to-end verification so rebuild2 proves bounded dirty work, resumability, and responsive review reads at 2M-article scale.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated performance tests remain deterministic and validate bounded dirty-batch work, DuckDB writer queue-wait observability, and memory/spill reporting without relying on exact timings.

Manual 2M synthetic run proves ten dirty articles claim at most ten dirty article IDs, committed dirty-refresh row counts stay batch-bounded, review warnings/details p95 stays under 2s while maintenance runs, restart resumes from durable state, and promotion does not wait for cleanup.
Filtered review reads return correct labels/results while a large-rebuild job is in progress.
Browser and desktop review-page smoke passes after server-side gates pass.
